# docunlock

> Removes Track Changes and editing restrictions from password-protected .docx files so you can redline freely. Runs entirely in the browser using JSZip; nothing is uploaded.

## How it works
A .docx file is a ZIP archive. Document protection (forced Track Changes, read-only, comments-only, forms-only) is recorded as a `<w:documentProtection>` element inside `word/settings.xml`. docunlock opens the archive in the browser, removes that element, repackages the file, and offers the result as `unlocked_<original name>.docx`.

## What it does not do
It only removes the protection flag. It does not decrypt a document that was encrypted with an open password (the kind Word demands before showing any content). It does not recover or reveal the protection password.

## Primary page
- [docunlock](https://nkostelnik.github.io/docunlock/): the tool itself.
